desc: A flaw was found in the DPDK GSO library. title: Dpdk: dpdk: missing memory size validation before mmap in vhost memory region setup
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. Memory size is not adequately validated before mmap during vhost memory-region setup, which can lead to a host crash or memory corruption.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: control-queue descriptor double-fetch overflows host heap in dpdk vhost (vduse)
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A TOCTOU double-fetch of control-queue descriptors allows a heap buffer overflow with attacker-controlled content in the VDUSE control-queue handler.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: double offset bug in vhost log mapping calculation
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A double-offset bug in vhost log mapping calculation can lead to incorrect memory access.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: guest can desynchronize virtqueue size from inflight descriptor table size, causing out-of-bounds write
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A guest can desynchronize virtqueue size from inflight descriptor table size, causing an out-of-bounds write in the host vhost process.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: guest with runt rx descriptors underflows copy length in vhost enqueue (split and packed rings)
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. A guest with runt RX descriptors can underflow the copy length in vhost enqueue, causing a denial of service in a shared vhost backend such as OVS-DPDK.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: vduse handler fails to invalidate vring pointers when iotlb is invalidated, leading to use-after-unmap
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost. The VDUSE handler fails to invalidate vring pointers when the IOTLB is invalidated, leading to use-after-unmap.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: guest-triggered use-after-free and type confusion in vhost-crypto session cleanup
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. Session cleanup can leave a stale cached session pointer, and the data path does not check the session type before attaching it, leading to use-after-free or type confusion in the host vhost-crypto backend.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: guest can trigger out-of-bounds write by controlling avail ring index in vhost-crypto
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. A guest can supply an avail-ring descriptor index that is used without bounds checking, causing an out-of-bounds write in the host vhost-crypto backend.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: guest can trigger infinite loop in vhost-crypto writeback chain cleanup
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. Write-back chain cleanup can follow an uninitialized next pointer when mapping a guest descriptor fails, causing the host vhost-crypto process to hang or crash.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: time-of-check/time-of-use vulnerability allowing guest-triggered out-of-bounds write in vhost-crypto
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. The indirect-descriptor snapshot double-fetches a guest descriptor next index, allowing a malicious guest to cause an out-of-bounds access in the host backend.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: integer overflow combined with missing validation leads to host buffer overflow in vhost-crypto
desc: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. Integer overflow in chain length checks, and missing length checks on the RSA path, can overflow a host buffer in the vhost-crypto backend.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: stack and heap buffer overflow in nfp vdpa driver
desc: A flaw was found in the DPDK nfp vDPA driver. Stack and heap buffers sized for a single queue pair can be overflowed when more virtqueues are configured, leading to a host crash or memory corruption.

title: Dpdk: dpdk: guest-triggered out-of-bounds walk via vhost indirect descriptor length toctou
desc: A flaw was found in the DPDK vhost library. desc: Capgo before 12.128.2 contains a broken row level security policy in the org_users table that allows authenticated users to elevate privileges from admin to super_admin. Attackers can exploit the insufficient RLS enforcement to gain unauthorized super_admin access and compromise system security.

title: Capgo - Unauthenticated Organization Member Email Disclosure via get_org_members RPC
desc: Capgo before 12.128.2 contains an improper access control vulnerability in the public.get_org_members RPC function that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate organization members. Attackers can invoke the endpoint using only the public sb_publishable_* key and an organization UUID to retrieve sensitive member information including email addresses, user IDs, roles, and pending invitations.

title: Crawl4AI - Arbitrary File Write via output_path Parameter
desc: Crawl4AI before 0.8.7 contains an arbitrary file write vulnerability in the Docker API server's /screenshot and /pdf endpoints. The output_path parameter accepts arbitrary filesystem paths without validation, allowing an attacker to supply absolute or path-traversal values to write to any location writable by the application's user, overwriting server files and causing denial of service.

title: Crawl4AI - Server-Side Request Forgery via Webhook URLs
desc: Crawl4AI before 0.8.7 contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the Docker API server's /crawl/job and /llm/job endpoints, which accept webhook URLs without destination validation. title: Crawl4AI - Unauthenticated Access to Monitor Endpoints via Docker API Server
desc: Crawl4AI before 0.8.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the monitor router endpoints that allows unauthenticated attackers to access destructive operations. Remote attackers can invoke the /monitor/actions/cleanup endpoint and manipulate monitoring state without authentication, causing service disruption.

title: Crawl4AI - Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Monitor Dashboard
desc: Crawl4AI before 0.8.7 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the monitor dashboard that renders crawl URLs and error messages via innerHTML without escaping. An attacker can submit a crafted crawl request with malicious markup that executes in an operator's browser when viewing the dashboard.

title: Crawl4AI - Arbitrary JavaScript Execution via /execute_js Endpoint
desc: Crawl4AI before 0.8.7 contains an arbitrary JavaScript execution vulnerability in the Docker API server's /execute_js endpoint, which accepts and executes arbitrary user-supplied JavaScript in the server's browser context with --disable-web-security enabled. An attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript and, combined with the browser's relaxed security settings, perform server-side request forgery

title: Crawl4AI - Authentication Bypass via Hardcoded JWT Signing Key
desc: Crawl4AI before 0.8.7 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability due to a hardcoded default JWT signing key in the Docker API server. Attackers who know the default key can forge valid authentication tokens for any user, bypassing authentication and gaining full access to protected functionality.

title: Crawl4AI - Server-Side Request Forgery via Direct Crawl Endpoints
desc: Crawl4AI before 0.8.7 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the /crawl, /crawl/stream, /md, and /llm endpoints that fetch arbitrary user-supplied URLs without validation. Unauthenticated attackers can bypass the internal-address blocklist using IPv6-mapped IPv4 addresses to reach internal services and cloud metadata endpoints.

title: Flowise - PII Disclosure via Unauthenticated Forgot Password Endpoint
desc: Flowise before 3.0.13 contains an information exposure vulnerability in the POST /api/v1/account/forgot-password endpoint that returns full user objects including PII to unauthenticated attackers. An attacker can enumerate valid email addresses and harvest sensitive user data including user IDs, names, account status, and timestamps by sending requests with known email addresses.

title: Flowise - Mass Assignment in PUT /api/v1/user Allows Password Hash Override
desc: Flowise before 3.1.2 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in the PUT /api/v1/user endpoint that allows authenticated users to directly modify the credential field without validation. Attackers can bypass password change verification and session invalidation by supplying a crafted password hash, establishing persistent account access after temporary session compromise.

title: Capgo - Information Disclosure via Unauthenticated /replication Endpoint
desc: Capgo before 12.128.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the unauthenticated /replication endpoint that exposes internal PostgreSQL replication telemetry including slot names and WAL LSN positions. title: capacitor-native-biometric - Authentication Bypass via Unvalidated CryptoObject in onAuthenticationSucceeded
desc: capacitor-native-biometric before 12.128.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability where the onAuthenticationSucceeded() method fails to validate CryptoObject parameters. Attackers can hook the onAuthenticationSucceeded() function using dynamic instrumentation to bypass biometric authentication without valid credentials.

title: Capgo - Policy Enforcement Bypass in Webhook Management Endpoints via Non-Expiring API Keys
desc: Capgo before 12.128.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in webhook management endpoints that allows non-expiring API keys to bypass the require_apikey_expiration organization policy. title: Capgo - Denial of Service via Unauthenticated OPTIONS Request to /build/upload Endpoint
desc: Capgo before 12.128.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the /build/upload/:jobId/* endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to trigger consistent 500 errors. Remote attackers can send OPTIONS requests to bypass authentication middleware and invoke tusProxy logic with invalid credentials, enabling trivial request flooding and denial of service.

title: picklescan - Arbitrary File Creation via logging.FileHandler Deserialization
desc: picklescan before 1.0.1 contains an unsafe pickle deserialization vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to create arbitrary zero-byte files via logging.FileHandler class instantiation. title: Cap-go - Broken Cursor Pagination in /private/devices Endpoint
desc: Cap-go before 12.128.12 contains a broken cursor pagination vulnerability in the /private/devices endpoint on the Cloudflare/workerd path that allows authenticated attackers to cause duplicate-page loops and make later rows unreachable. title: Cap-go - Job Existence Oracle via Unauthenticated OPTIONS /build/upload/:jobId/*
desc: Cap-go before 12.128.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the OPTIONS /build/upload/:jobId/* endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate valid builder job IDs through observable response discrepancies. Attackers can probe the endpoint without authentication to distinguish valid job IDs from invalid ones and generate sustained unauthenticated traffic for resource co

title: Nuxt - Cross-Site Scripting via NoScript Component Slot Content
desc: Nuxt before 4.4.7 (and the 3.x branch before 3.21.7) contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in the NoScript component that writes slot content to innerHTML without escaping. Attackers can inject malicious scripts through untrusted data in NoScript slots, such as route.query parameters, which execute in the document context when the noscript tag is implicitly closed by script tags.

title: Capgo - App Existence Oracle via GET /statistics/app/:app_id
desc: Capgo before 12.128.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the GET /statistics/app/:app_id endpoint that allows app-limited API keys to distinguish existing sibling app IDs through differential error responses. title: Capgo - App ID Confusion via ILIKE Wildcard in Preview Subdomain Lookup
desc: Capgo before 12.128.2 uses ILIKE pattern matching instead of exact matching for app_id lookup in the preview subdomain resolver, allowing underscore characters in app_id to act as SQL wildcards. Attackers can create apps with app_ids differing by one character at underscore positions to cause unintended pattern matches, breaking preview functionality for legitimate apps or causing app-id confusion

title: Capgo - Open Redirect via Unvalidated Stripe Billing URLs
desc: Capgo before 12.128.2 contains an open redirect vulnerability in stripe_portal and stripe_checkout endpoints that accept unvalidated callbackUrl, successUrl, and cancelUrl parameters. Authenticated attackers can craft malicious billing URLs to redirect users to attacker-controlled domains for phishing and credential harvesting.

title: Capgo - Open Redirect via confirmation_url Parameter
desc: Capgo before 12.128.2 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the confirm-signup endpoint that allows attackers to redirect users to arbitrary external websites. The confirmation_url parameter is not validated, enabling attackers to craft malicious links for phishing and credential harvesting attacks.

title: AVideo - Unauthenticated Access to Payment Log DataTables Endpoints via list.json.php
desc: AVideo through version 26.0 contains multiple unauthenticated list.json.php endpoints in payment plugins lacking authorization checks, exposing PayPal tokens, Authorize.Net webhooks, and Bitcoin transaction records. Unauthenticated attackers can retrieve all payment transaction data including agreement IDs, user financial records, and API responses via direct GET requests to vulnerable endpoints.

title: AVideo - Server-Side Request Forgery in Live/test.php via statsURL Parameter
desc: AVideo through version 27.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in plugin/Live/test.php that allows authenticated administrators to read arbitrary URLs via the statsURL parameter, which lacks isSSRFSafeURL() validation and accepts requests to private IP ranges and cloud metadata endpoints. title: AVideo - Arbitrary User Session Hijacking via Meet Plugin uploadRecordedVideo Endpoint
desc: AVideo through 29.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the Meet plugin's uploadRecordedVideo.json.php endpoint that derives the target users_id from the uploaded filename without verification. title: AVideo - Unauthenticated PGP Message Decryption via decryptMessage.json.php Endpoint
desc: AVideo through version 25.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the decryptMessage.json.php endpoint that allows unauthenticated users to decrypt PGP messages. Remote attackers can submit private keys, ciphertext, and passphrases to perform server-side decryption without credentials, exposing key material to logs and enabling resource exhaustion attacks.

title: AVideo TopMenu Plugin - Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Unescaped Menu Item Fields
desc: AVideo TopMenu plugin through version 26.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in menu item rendering due to missing output encoding of icon classes, URLs, and text labels. Attackers can inject malicious JavaScript through unescaped menu item fields that execute for all site visitors, potentially stealing session cookies or performing unauthorized actions.

title: ImageMagick - Heap Out-of-Bounds Read in PSB RLE Decoding
desc: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-15 and 6.9.x before 6.9.13-40 contains an integer overflow in the PSB (PSD v2) RLE decoding path (ReadPSDChannelRLE in coders/psd.c) that causes a heap out-of-bounds read on 32-bit builds. Processing a crafted PSB file can lead to information disclosure or a crash.

title: ImageMagick - Heap Out-of-Bounds Read in PCD Decoder
desc: ImageMagick before 7.1.2-15 (and 6.x before 6.9.13-40) contains a heap out-of-bounds read in the PCD coder's DecodeImage loop. A crafted PCD file can trigger a one-byte heap out-of-bounds read during image decoding, resulting in denial of service and potential disclosure of an adjacent heap byte.

title: Craft CMS - Stored XSS via User Group Name in User Permissions Page
desc: Craft CMS from version 5.0.0-RC1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the User Permissions page where user group names are rendered without proper HTML escaping. Attackers with admin access can inject arbitrary JavaScript via the user group name field that executes when other users view or edit permissions.

title: Craft CMS - Remote Code Execution via Missing Config Sanitization in FieldsController
desc: Craft CMS (composer package craftcms/cms) versions >= 5.5.0 and <= 5.9.13 contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the FieldsController::actionRenderCardPreview() method, which passes the fieldLayoutConfig POST parameter directly to Fields::createLayout() without calling Component::cleanseConfig(). title: Craft CMS - Stored XSS in Table Field via Row Heading Column Type
desc: Craft CMS contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the editableTable.twig component when using the 'Row Heading' column type. title: Craft CMS - Missing Authorization in assets/preview-thumb Endpoint
desc: Craft CMS contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the assets/preview-thumb endpoint. desc: Craft CMS versions >= 5.0.0-RC1, <= 5.9.13 and >= 4.0.0-RC1, <= 4.17.7 contain an authorization bypass in the assets/preview-file endpoint. desc: Craft CMS 4.x (>= 4.0.0-RC1, < 4.17.0-beta.1) and 5.x (>= 5.0.0-RC1, < 5.9.0-beta.1) contain multiple stored cross-site scripting vulnerabilities where settings names and field option labels are rendered without sanitization (e.g., via the checkbox.twig template, which used {{ label|raw }}). title: Craft CMS - Authenticated Path Traversal in assets/icon Extension Parameter
desc: Craft CMS from 4.0.0-RC1 contains an authenticated path traversal vulnerability in the assets/icon endpoint where the extension parameter is not validated before file existence checks. Attackers can bypass extension validation by passing traversal sequences that resolve to existing SVG files, allowing local file read access.

title: phpMyFAQ - Privilege Escalation via Missing Authorization in editUser() and updateUserRights()
desc: phpMyFAQ before 4.1.4 contains missing authorization vulnerabilities in editUser() and updateUserRights() endpoints that allow authenticated administrators to escalate privileges. desc: SiYuan before v3.6.1 fails to sanitize package metadata and README content in the Bazaar marketplace, allowing malicious package authors to inject arbitrary HTML and JavaScript. desc: Maxun before 0.0.42 contains a cross-tenant insecure direct object reference vulnerability in storage and webhook API handlers that allows authenticated users to access other users' robots and OAuth tokens. title: NewsBlur < 14.5.0 - Server-Side Request Forgery via add_url Endpoint
desc: NewsBlur before version 14.5.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the add_url endpoint that allows authenticated users to make arbitrary server requests to internal networks by failing to filter private IP addresses. Attackers can exploit this to access localhost services and cloud metadata endpoints, enabling internal network scanning and sensitive data exfiltration.

title: NewsBlur < 14.5.0 - Insecure Direct Object Reference in Social Interactions Endpoint
desc: NewsBlur before 14.5.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read private notification feeds by supplying arbitrary user_id values to the GET /social/interactions endpoint without ownership verification. Attackers can enumerate user_id values to access another user's follows, replies, and social activity without authorization.

title: Teable - Missing Authorization in v2 REST API
desc: Teable's v2 REST API controller lacks @Permissions metadata on ORPC endpoints, allowing any authenticated user to bypass authorization checks. Attackers can read table schemas, create tables, and modify or delete records across bases and tables via endpoints like GET /api/v2/tables/get and POST /api/v2/tables/updateRecords.

title: PhotoPrism - Unauthorized User Profile Modification via PUT /api/v1/users/{uid} Endpoint

title: Gst-plugins-bad: gst-plugins-bad: integer overflows and division by zero in jpeg 2000 decimator
desc: A flaw was found in the GStreamer JPEG 2000 decimator in gst-plugins-bad. Crafted JPEG 2000 media can cause integer overflows or division by zero during tile processing. An application that processes the malicious media may crash, resulting in a denial of service.

title: phpMyAdmin ShapeFile SHP File loadFromFile infinite loop
desc: A vulnerability has been found in phpMyAdmin ShapeFile up to 4.0.1. Impacted is the function ShapeRecord::loadFromFile of the component SHP File Handler. Such manipulation leads to infinite loop. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

title: Tournamatch < 4.7.1 - Subscriber+ Arbitrary File Deletion
desc: The Tournamatch WordPress plugin before 4.7.1 does not validate or restrict the path of a previously stored profile or team image before deleting it when a new image is uploaded, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to delete arbitrary files on the server, such as wp-config.php, which can lead to a full site takeover.

title: Tournamatch < 4.7.1 - Unauthenticated Team Invitation Email Disclosure via REST API
desc: The Tournamatch WordPress plugin before 4.7.1 does not restrict access to its team invitation listing, allowing unauthenticated users to retrieve the email addresses of people invited to join teams.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 Denial of Service via WinPR PNG/JPEG Image Readers
desc: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in WinPR's winpr_read_png_from_buffer() and winpr_convert_from_jpeg(), which lack libpng/libjpeg error handling. A malicious RDP server or MITM can offer a malformed PNG or truncated JPEG clipboard payload, causing the client to abort or exit.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 Null Pointer Crash via ARM Gateway Response
desc: FreeRDP 3.0.0 before 3.32.2 built with WITH_AAD=ON contains a reachable assertion because its ARM gateway response parser accepts a missing or non-string redirectedServerCert field and passes a null buffer to the certificate parser. A malicious or malformed user-selected gateway can return such a response to abort the client process.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 Denial of Service via RemoteFX RLGR decoder
desc: FreeRDP from 3.11.0 before 3.32.2 contains an assertion failure in the RemoteFX RLGR decoder that allows malicious servers to terminate clients. Attackers controlling an RDP server can send a RemoteFX tileset with RLGR code 32767, triggering a signed narrowing assertion in rfx_rlgr_decode and crashing the client.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 Use-After-Free via dyn-channel-dump Module
desc: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a cross-thread use-after-free vulnerability in the freerdp-proxy dyn-channel-dump module during session teardown. A malicious RDP target can send dynamic channel data while the front client disconnects, letting the client thread read freed ChannelData and crash the proxy process.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 X11 Client Crash via Zero-Width RDPGFX ResetGraphics
desc: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that allows malicious RDP servers to crash xfreerdp clients by sending a zero-width RDPGFX ResetGraphics PDU. The failed resize in gdi_resize_ex leaves the primary display null without ending the session, so a later bitmap update crashes the client in gdi_Bitmap_Paint.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 Client Denial of Service via Zero-Output ZGFX Payload
desc: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 allows a client assertion abort because rdpgfx_on_data_received rejects only negative zgfx_decompress status and passes the resulting null output pointer to Stream_StaticConstInit. A malicious RDP server can send a zero-output ZGFX payload on the RDPGFX channel after session activation to terminate the client.

title: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 Denial of Service via RDPGFX ALPHA WIRETOSURFACE_2
desc: FreeRDP before 3.32.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the RDPGFX ALPHA WIRETOSURFACE_2 handler that fails to validate zero surface dimensions. A malicious RDP server can send a crafted WIRETOSURFACE_2 PDU with zero width and height, triggering an assertion or division by zero that terminates the client session.

title: Parse Server before 8.6.110 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.6-alpha.2 Denial of Service via afterSave Pointer Update
desc: Parse Server before 8.6.110 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.6-alpha.2 fails to contain a serialization error when an object update uses a dot notation key targeting a pointer field's object identifier on a class with an afterSave trigger. Attackers, including unauthenticated clients when objects are writable without a session, can send such an update to crash the Node process.

title: SurrealDB 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 Incorrect Authorization via Streaming Index Planner
desc: SurrealDB from 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows record users to infer restricted field values because the streaming planner uses indexes on fields with restrictive SELECT permissions. Attackers can issue full-text MATCHES, compound B-tree, or HNSW KNN queries against restricted fields to learn which records contain guessed values or nearest vectors.

title: SurrealDB from 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 SSRF via JWKS Implicit Default Port Bypass
desc: SurrealDB from 3.1.0 before 3.3.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows database Owners to bypass port-specific deny-net rules by using JWKS URLs with implicit default ports. Attackers can configure a JWT or record access method whose JWKS URL omits port 80 or 443, causing blind GET requests to explicitly denied internal services.

title: Nodemailer 3.0.0 before 10.1.4 Recipient Domain Confusion via addressparser
desc: Nodemailer from 3.0.0 before 10.1.4 contains an address parsing vulnerability in addressparser that ends an angle-addr at a '>' inside a quoted local part, comment or domain literal. Attackers can submit addresses that validate as an allowed domain but are delivered to an attacker-controlled domain, bypassing recipient allow lists and disclosing message content.

title: AzuraCast before 0.24.0 Missing Authorization via Station Waveform Endpoints
desc: AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the GET and POST /api/station/{station_id}/waveform/{media_id} routes, which lack Permissions middleware. Any authenticated user without station assignment can read another station's cached waveform JSON and overwrite it with attacker-supplied data, corrupting Visual Cue Editor data.

title: Froxlor 2.3.0 before 2.3.15 Authorization Bypass via Certificates.update API
desc: Froxlor 2.3.0 before 2.3.15 contains a missing authorization check in the Certificates.add and Certificates.update API commands, which do not verify whether a domain's certificate is Let's Encrypt-managed. title: Mistune before 3.3.3 Denial of Service via Balanced Bracket Link Parsing
desc: Mistune before 3.3.3 contains a denial of service vulnerability in InlineParser.parse_link that allows attackers to cause quadratic CPU growth by supplying balanced nested brackets. Attackers can submit crafted Markdown with thousands of nested bracket pairs not forming a valid link, triggering repeated _contains_nested_link scans that exhaust CPU in parsing applications.

title: Frappe HRMS before 15.61.0 Permission Bypass via Expense Claim Advances API
desc: Frappe HRMS before 15.61.0 contains a permission bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated employees to view other employees' expense advance details due to improper authorization checks. Attackers can query the Expense Claim Advances API to retrieve expense advance records belonging to other employees, exposing sensitive financial information.

title: svg-sanitizer 0.5.0 before 1.1.0 Incomplete url() Filtering in SVG Attributes
desc: svg-sanitizer from 0.5.0 before 1.1.0 contains an incomplete filtering vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass remote URL removal by using CSS escape sequences inside url() in SVG presentation attributes. Attackers can supply SVG files with attributes like fill containing escaped slashes that browsers resolve to remote URLs, triggering external requests and enabling data exfiltration.

title: CFNext before 3.1.0 Admin Password Recovery via MD5-Derived Subscription UUID
desc: CFNext before 3.1.0 contains a weak cryptographic derivation vulnerability that allows subscription link holders to recover the admin password because the subscription UUID is an MD5 of the password with a fixed public salt. Attackers can brute-force the password offline without rate limiting, log into the admin panel, and read stored Trojan, Clash, Telegram and Cloudflare API secrets.

title: Padloc through 4.3.0 Missing SCIM Token Validation via SCIM GET Requests
desc: Padloc through 4.3.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in ScimServer._handleScimGet() that allows unauthenticated attackers to read SCIM directories by sending any non-empty bearer token. Attackers who know an organization id can query the Users and Groups SCIM endpoints to retrieve provisioned usernames, emails, names, externalIds, and group memberships.

title: Fiber Admin 3.1.0 - 4.0.0 - Unauthenticated RCE via Host Header
desc: The Fiber Admin WordPress plugin before 4.0.1 does not validate or escape a request header before writing it into a PHP file it regenerates on an unprotected admin hook, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code when its custom database error page is enabled and they win a race against an administrator saving its settings.

title: Fiber Admin < 4.0.1 - Unauthenticated Arbitrary Post and Term Order Modification via fiad_cpo_update and fiad_cpo_tax_update
desc: The Fiber Admin WordPress plugin before 4.0.1 does not have authorisation checks in some of its AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to change the order of arbitrary posts, including drafts, private posts and navigation menu items, as well as the order of taxonomy terms when term ordering is enabled.

desc: Dreeve before 5.8.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in StravaWebhookRequestHandler::handleEvent that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge Strava webhook events without signature, verify-token or owner_id checks. desc: nnn through 5.3 contains an insecure temporary file vulnerability in the pdfread and nuke plugins that allows local attackers to overwrite files by exploiting predictable paths in /tmp. title: Label Studio before 1.23.2 SSRF and Token Disclosure via Image Export Downloads
